Attention gets treated like weather, something that just happens to us, but it behaves more like a budget we can decide how to spend. The idea of allocating it deliberately changes how you think about tools, feeds, and the creative work you protect. https://vibrationofawesome.com/blog/boom/posts/attention-as-a-resource-you-can-allocate-on-purpose #attention #creatortools #productivity

You are probably carrying more than you realize.
